title: Pauline Oliveros
hero_prompt: Wide darkfield linocut print, stark black ink on cream paper. A single large ear rendered as landscape — the auricle becomes rolling hills, the canal a river vanishing into distance. Concentric sound-rings radiate outward from the center like water disturbed by a stone, filling the whole field. Deep shadows, no gradients, woodblock texture throughout. The image evokes total listening — sound arriving from every direction at once. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square linocut emblem: a stylized ear in profile, filled with tight concentric arcs suggesting a sonic field radiating outward. Maximum contrast — black ink on cream or white ground. Thick lines only, no fine detail, no hatching finer than 3px at 48px scale. No letters, numerals, words, labels.
